Description
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console
Petstore admin console: the /console page tree.
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev
Petstore console Developer pages: custom cards, themes, rendering flavors and the secure API demo.

Petstore console Rendering flavors: one console page per petstore view technology.
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.ops
Petstore console operations pages: background jobs and the audit log.

Petstore console orders page and its JSON endpoints.

Petstore console pets pages and their JSON endpoints.

Petstore console users page and its JSON endpoints.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view
Engine-agnostic server-side-rendered view extension point.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker
Apache FreeMarker view-rendering bridge — opt-in juneau-rest-server-view-freemarker module.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console
FreeMarker-only delivery of the admin-console chrome: the reserved-classpath base.ftlh template, the <@tag> macro, and ConsoleFreemarkerMixin (registers a reserved-path ClassTemplateLoader on top of the host's own FreemarkerMixin configuration).
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.jsp
JSP view-rendering bridge — opt-in juneau-rest-server-view-jsp module.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.mustache
Mustache view-rendering bridge — opt-in juneau-rest-server-view-mustache module.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.thymeleaf
Thymeleaf view-rendering bridge — opt-in juneau-rest-server-view-thymeleaf module.
